title: Guided by Light | Sea Star Illuminates HK ILF（Autumn Edition）
paras: Time flies, and light leaves an enduring mark. On October 30, the Hong Kong International Lighting Fair (Autumn Edition) – a landmark event that garners global attention in the lighting industry – officially concluded. With the theme of “Innovative Design, Intelligent Lighting for the Future”, this year’s fair served as a global hub, bringing together top-tier lighting enterprises, professional buyers, and industry elites from across the world. It showcased the latest cutting-edge technologies, trend-setting designs, and innovative products that are shaping the future of the lighting sector.​

As a lighting enterprise deeply committed to R&D, manufacturing, and global market expansion, Sea Star made a remarkable impression at the fair. Since the opening day, we showcased a series of star products that fully comply with international safety standards and energy efficiency requirements. These products, characterized by innovative light effects and superior quality, attracted extensive attention from industry partners, long-term clients, and potential customers at our booth – Booth No.: 5C-D29/D35.​

We extend our sincere gratitude to every visitor who stopped by for in-depth exchanges. Your recognition of Sea Star’s products and brand philosophy is the most valuable motivation driving our continuous progress.​

Over the several days of the fair, the Sea Star team maintained a high level of efficiency and enthusiasm in serving every visitor. To ensure smooth communication, our product managers and sales team prepared detailed product manuals in advance. They listened carefully to customers’ market demands, quickly screened customized solutions, and provided professional explanations on product test parameters, performance characteristics, and application scenarios – earning praise for their professionalism and responsiveness.​

While the Hong Kong International Lighting Fair (Autumn Edition) has come to an end, the “light of innovation” at Sea Star never fades. This fair was not only a precious opportunity to reunite with long-standing partners but also a crucial starting point for dialogue with the future of the lighting industry.​

Looking ahead, Sea Star will continue to closely monitor global market regulations and evolving customer needs. We will invest more in R&D to launch more cutting-edge technologies and reliable products, and provide more flexible cooperation models. We are committed to walking hand in hand with global partners, co-creating value, and moving toward a brighter future for the lighting industry.​
For more updates on Sea Star’s products and projects, please stay tuned to our official website.

title: 2025 GILE|Sea Star Invites You to Join the Feast of Light-powered IOT

Driven by uncompromising quality and relentless innovation, Sea Star unveiled its smart lighting portfolio—including downlights, ceiling lights, panel lights, vanity lights, and LED strips—showcasing both present-day applications and future-forward IoT experiences.

Anchored in deep violet and crisp white, the open-concept design featured clean architectural lines that allowed unobstructed viewing. Every exhibit was strategically positioned to demonstrate Sea Star's latest advancements across residential, commercial, and intelligent lighting solutions to global visitors.

Moving forward, Sea Star remains committed to its innovation-driven, quality-first philosophy, continually developing smarter, greener lighting solutions. Our mission endures: to illuminate lives worldwide, ensuring Sea Star's light reaches every corner of the globe.

title: Winter Team Building
paras: When the warm winter sun fell, maple leaves dyed red branches, on December 24, Wuxi Seastar Lighting Co., Ltd. held a unique team building activity -- winter mountaineering, to welcome the New Year and start a new journey in 2025.

The venue for this event was the scenic Huishan. In the winter morning, the energetic Seastar's members came to the foot of Huishan early to assemble into a team.  All of them were energetic and ready to win.  The breeze brought with the fresh smell of the woods.  After a brief collection and oath, the climbing activities officially kicked off. Everyone carried the "power bag" which was carefully prepared by the company, facing the warm winter sun, stepping into the depths of nature and setting out for the top of the mountain!

The mountain road twists and turns, the team's pace is sonorous. Everyone threw off their arms, stride forward.  Some members were in front of the road, some members were in the back to encourage forward; Some members struggled, some members lent a helping hand, supportted all th way; Some members were physically weak, dizzied and stopped, some members were around, never abandoned. It was not so much a game as a team battle, and taking the top of Huishan was the common goal of everyone.
The winter mountains have a different charm. They enjoyed the beauty along the way while encouraging each other, the mountains filled with laughter.

With the concerted efforts of everyone, all the members have successfully reached the summit, although it has been winter, everyone was sweating. When standing on the top of the mountain, overlooking thousands of miles, everyone's face was filled with the joy of victory and the pride of challenging success, and the exhaustion of the whole body was instantly cured.  Many staff picked up cameras to record this beautiful moment.
In the end, the first, fourth and sixth team respectively won the first, second and third place of the mountaineering team building activity.

After that, all the members went down the hill in an orderly manner and gathered together to enjoy the food. Climb the mountain to the top, the struggle will never stop. This mountaineering activity not only exercises the personal will, deepens the friendship between colleagues, and further unites the Seastar's staff closely together!
December is not only the end of the year, but also the prelude to the next year, Wuxi Seastar Lighting will work together and strive to sprint to reach the top of the mountain and achieve the goal!

title: The classroom lights and blackboard lights are shipped from Seastar Lighting for the first time
paras: 几分钟了解教室灯和黑板灯
教室灯和黑板灯有什么不一样?
广义上，教室灯是包含黑板灯的，但是在学校照明设计方案上，教室灯只是负责照亮学生桌面和讲台的灯具，是不包含黑板灯在内的，因为黑板的照明需要另外一种灯具来完成。
一个好的教室照明环境可以提供舒适的照明质量，减少视觉疲劳，从而有利于师生身心健康。那么应该选择什么样的灯具作为教室照明光源呢？益明专门为此研究设计了以下2款灯具。
产品介绍
教室灯
益明新品教室灯，额定功率36W，光通量达到3000lm，色温4000K/5000K，寿命达到30000h，产品尺寸为1200*290*90mm。
黑板灯
益明新品黑板灯，额定功率36W，光通量达到3600lm，色温4000K/5000K，寿命达到30000h，产品尺寸为1200*121*70mm。
应用场景
益明新品教室灯、黑板灯将广泛应用于中小学课堂，为师生提供优质的照明环境。
首次出货
上周，益明首次顺利出货教室灯和黑板灯。虽然2020年伊始疫情来势汹汹，照明行业受到大力冲击，但是益明凭借自身的稳健性和前瞻性，提前布局好未来的发展方向，在困难面前，体现出独特的竞争优势。
2020年，益明蓄势待发！！
